persona.role: colleague reporting on direct access proposals

sent_to_model:
I need to update colleagues on the UDCs' joint proposal for implementing the direct access suspension. They're asking the Commission to approve the conditions I've noted below: customer lists and existing contracts, account changes, and three additional implementation options. Please cover the filing and comment dates, the proposed DASR eligibility and account-change rules, and those three options. Make clear these are proposals awaiting approval. There are two different cutoff formulations for individual ESP switches in the proposal; don't settle whether contracts signed exactly on September 20 qualify. Please tell colleagues to call Jeanne with questions.

- Seamless moves permitted within one UDC's territory.
- UDCs filed Friday November 16; comments due Wednesday November 28, 2001.
- Residential and small commercial DASRs require the ESP to demonstrate that required third-party verification occurred before September 20, 2001.
- Additional option: ESP affidavit linking each DASR to a contract existing September 20, 2001; UDCs supplied proposed affidavit.
- Customer identity changes considered individually; changing business type is not allowed.
- ESP list submission requires ESP/UDC Service Agreement valid September 20, 2001.
- Customers on bundled service September 20, 2001 excluded despite continuing DA contract and October 5 listing.
- Additional option: Commission sets deadline for receipt and acceptance of DASRs.
- ESP merger transferring all accounts needs no new DASR.
- Customer must appear on ESP list submitted October 5, 2001.
- Direct access rights cannot be transferred or assigned between customers.
- Small-customer ESPs also need Commission registration valid September 20, 2001.
- Additional option if no strict DASR cutoff: ESP submits account-specific DASR information, contract and eligibility explanation for processing after cutoff; UDC waits for Commission approval.
- Community aggregation customers joining after suspension excluded.
- Individual ESP switches require receiving-ESP contract; proposal uses both before September 20 and on/before September 20, 2001.
- Joint UDC implementation plan seeks Commission approval.

(About me: colleague reporting on direct access proposals. Length: it should come to roughly 400-800 words.)

must_cover: Report when the joint proposal was filed and when comments are due.
Summarize the proposed DASR eligibility and account-change rules, including customer moves and ESP changes.
Describe the three additional implementation options for Commission consideration.
Make clear the conditions are proposals awaiting Commission approval.
Tell colleagues to call Jeanne with questions.
must_not_reveal: A settled eligible-or-ineligible determination for individual ESP-switch contracts signed exactly on September 20, 2001; the proposal uses conflicting cutoff formulations.

reference.kind: a real piece of writing by a real person

source.licence_note: Enron corpus (FERC public release); HF card: unknown
